assessment_summary: I reviewed the guide (Node.js 22 prerequisite; npm ci; npm run dev on :3000; npm run lint; npm run build producing static export to out/) and the installation summary, then independently confirmed the environment. Runtime: Node v22.11.0 and npm 10.9.0 are installed in /usr/local/bin, satisfying the guide's Node 22 requirement. Dependencies: npm ls resolves next@15.3.0, react@19.1.0, react-dom@19.1.0 and node_modules contains 317 entries, consistent with the reported npm ci success. Lint: `npm run lint` returned 'No ESLint warnings or errors' with exit 0. Build artifact: /workspace/out contains the full static export (all six route HTML pages plus 404.html, favicon, and _next/static bundles), matching the documented `output: 'export'` in next.config.mjs. Operational behavior: I started `npm run dev` (Next.js 15.3.0 became Ready in 2.4s) and confirmed HTTP 200 for the root and all five content routes, with the correct page title; I also served the static export directory over a temporary local server and got HTTP 200 with correct content, demonstrating the build output is functional standalone. Both test servers were shut down afterward. I did not re-run `npm run build` because validation boundaries prohibit building; instead I relied on the existing out/ artifacts and the successful lint/dev runs. No abandoned alternative install method left required files missing, and no pre-existing process was expected to be running. All checks align with the documented workflow, so the installation is complete and operational.
